    Three-vehicle crash involving school bus sends patients to hospitals in Hemet

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:45
    Instaread
    By
    Brian Briggs
    -
    October 1, 2026
    Share
    Facebook
    Twitter
    Pinterest
    WhatsApp
      A three-vehicle accident involving a Hemet School Bus prompted a response from Hemet firefighters, police and American Medical Response at 11:32 a.m. at 1211 S. Sanderson Ave.AMR personnel arrived first and reported that no students were aboard the bus.After arriving, the crew of Hemet Engine 4 requested three additional AMR units, bringing the total to four ambulances.All patients were transported to a local hospital. Their conditions and the number of people injured were not immediately available.
